mechanism: Amphetamine increases norepinephrine and dopamine release while isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits their metabolism, resulting in severe sympathomimetic toxicity and hypertensive crisis.
action: This combination is contraindicated; amphetamines must be avoided in patients taking MAOIs, and a minimum 14-day washout of isocarboxazid is required before initiating amphetamine therapy.
